sum: The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to large and mid-capitalization U.S. companies with high free cash flow yields. Companies with high free cash flow yields are commonly referred to as "cash cows". Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in U.S.-listed equity securities that are the component securities of the index.
